text:
Alex (Billing): Heads up 1 — a batch of NetSuite invoices posted this morning have totals that don't match Stripe's amount_due. Looks like discount lines present in Stripe are getting ignored by the NS transformer.
Priya (Payments): how many invoices? any obvious commonalities?
Alex (Billing): so far ~45 invoices, mixed subs and one-offs, discounts are coupon-based negative lines (-$10 to -$200). I pulled a sample Stripe invoice and the NS export side-by-side.
Omar (Reconciler): this rings a bell. We changed the billing-exporter last week to emit line items with `amount_cents` and `kind` instead of `amount`/`type`. Transformer mapping in net-sync might still be matching on `type==charge`. Negative lines may have `kind==discount` and we filter them out.
Lydia (Ops): can you paste the sample payloads?
Priya (Payments): sample from Stripe: 
```
{
  "id": "in_1Kxx...",
  "lines": {
    "data": [
      {"id":"li_1","type":"invoiceitem","amount":20000},
      {"id":"li_2","type":"discount","amount":-1500}
    ]
  },
  "amount_due": 18500
}
```
Alex (Billing): NetSuite invoice export shows only the positive invoiceitem line and `total:200.00`, so NS posted $15 more than Stripe.
Omar (Reconciler): confirmed: transformer code has an `is_positive_line` filter used during streaming rewrite. It only looks at `amount > 0` and discards negative values assuming they're refunds. That was intended for refund events, but discounts are negative line items and got dropped.
Priya (Payments): guess that explains unapplied credits and customer complaints. Any quick mitigation?
Lydia (Ops): Can't retroactively update posted invoices without a runbook. We could create credit memos in NetSuite for the missing discount lines. Ops prefers backfilling via a controlled job that writes discount lines as separate credit memos to avoid editing posted invoices.
Alex (Billing): Finance prefers credit memos too. We need estimate of GL impact and a preview CSV.
Omar (Reconciler): will add a hotfix: change filter to only drop lines with `type==refund` or explicit `event==refund`, allow negative `discount` lines to pass and map `discount` -> NS credit line with negative amount. Adding unit tests. PR incoming.
Priya (Payments): estimate impact: 45 invoices * average discount $55 = ~$2,475. Not material but we should fix quickly.
Lydia (Ops): I'll pull the affected invoice list and export to S3 for Finance review.
billing-bot: Notice: net-sync replay queue contains 12 related events for these invoices. Replay paused due to schema mismatch.
Alex (Billing): Replay paused is good. We don't want automatic replay until patch is deployed.
Finance Approvals: please include GL mapping for discount credit memos (Acct 3204 "Sales Discounts") and confirm cutover plan.
Omar (Reconciler): Runbook draft: 1) run dry-run to generate preview CSV (invoice_id, stripe_total, ns_total, missing_discount_amount), 2) Finance reviews and signs off, 3) write credit memos to NS sandbox and validate, 4) schedule production window (low traffic), 5) run production job to create credit memos and monitor reconciler.
Alex (Billing): tagging @Finance Approvals for signoff on the dry-run.
Priya (Payments): I've posted dry-run CSV to S3: s3://redwood-billing/dryruns/2309123456-discount-backfill-preview.csv
Alex (Billing): Reviewed sample rows 1 — looks good. Approve runbook contingent on ops scheduling.
Lydia (Ops): Scheduling maintenance window 03:00 PT tomorrow. Will coordinate NS sandbox test tonight.
Omar (Reconciler): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/net-sync/pull/778 (fix: allow discount negative lines + mapping + tests). Hoping for quick merge and deploy.
Finance Approvals: Approved pending dry-run validation. Please attach production checklist and GL code for credit memos.
Alex (Billing): GL code confirmed: 3204. Production checklist will be attached to the ops ticket.
Priya (Payments): after deploy I'll unpause replay and run backfill job. Will post completion update.
billing-bot: Update: net-sync deploy queued, replay remains paused until manual unpause.
Alex (Billing): thanks team. Follow-up tomorrow for confirmation and closure. :white_check_mark:
